faculty_program.name: Undergraduate Honour Schools / Second Public Examination

name: Oxford University Standardised Marks (USM) — Honour School class boundaries

credit_system.conversion_notes: Classification uses averaged University Standardised Marks, not a credit-weighted GPA.

provenance.note: Paper weights are course-specific in examination conventions.

gpa_formula.description: Agreed final marks are whole-number USMs 0–100. Course conventions average paper USMs; some conventions then symmetrically round the average to the nearest integer before classing.

repeat_course_rules.description: Resit rights are course-specific (see individual examination conventions). Not encoded as a single university rule.

pass_fail.description: Honour Schools use numeric USMs, not P/F, except where a paper is separately unclassed.

degree_classification.description: Second Public Examination / Honour Moderations class boundaries from Education Committee EAF (October 2025).
extra_conditions: Individual honour schools may raise a class above the average via strong-paper rules. Those extras are program-level schemes, not this university-wide boundary table.

official_sources.title: Examinations and Assessment Framework (EAF) October 2025 — University of Oxford

notes: Prelims/Moderations use Distinction/Pass/Fail bands (70 / 40) — store as a separate scheme if needed.
Part C / PGT papers on some integrated masters use a Distinction/Merit/Pass scale.
